title: The Quarry's Den
text: The den is empty: a hollow of trampled earth, bones gnawed clean, a nest of fur and feathers. In the middle, something it was guarding, small and alive and mewling. Far off, through the trees, something answers.

outcomes.text: Its bones will fetch a price. The quarry will come for it, and soon, and from behind.

options.label: Wait in the den for the parent.

outcomes.text: It comes home, and finds you there, and it is angry.

options.label: The gentlest leaves the young unharmed.

outcomes.text: The quarry finds it whole, and is slower to fight, and you are glad of it.
